leader_skill.desc: 150% Def, Max HP, 200% spark damage when HP is above 50%, damage taken may restore HP, 20% damage reduction when damage taken is over 5k & 15% DoT reduction
leader_skill.name: Pride of House Valen

extra_skill.desc: 20% all parameters for all allies, 0-100% Atk, Def, Rec relative to remaining HP, negates all status ailments and Atk Def, Rec reduction & probable 2 KO resistance
extra_skill.name: Return of the King

bb.desc: 23 combo Fire attack on all foes (damage relative to remaining HP), damage taken may restore HP for 3 turns, activates Taunt and boosts own Def, adds Fire barrier, 50% damage reduction for 3 turns & 25% DoT reduction for 2 turns
bb.name: Baldr's Cleave

sbb.desc: 27 combo Fire attack on all foes (damage relative to remaining HP), 8 combo Fire attack on single foe, boosts all elemental damage for 3 turns, boosts Def relative to max HP for 3 turns, damage taken fills BB gauge for 3 turns & 50% damage reduction for 3 turns
sbb.name: Gallant Flame

ubb.desc: 33 combo Fire attack on all foes (damage relative to remaining HP), boosts Fire elemental damage for 3 turns, boosts Def relative to Atk for 3 turns, adds Fire barrier, damage taken fills BB gauge for 3 turns & 100 damage reduction for 3 turns
ubb.name: Valiant Blaze
